+"""align_calendar spine: the dates every ticker has a close on, no fill."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from mdata.calendar import align_calendar
+from mdata.types import Prices, RawRow
+
+
+def test_sample_keeps_only_dates_every_ticker_has(contract_sample):

+    prices = align_calendar(rows)

+        dates=("2024-03-04", "2024-03-05", "2024-03-07"),
+        tickers=("A", "B"),
+        closes={"A": (100.0, 101.41, 100.4), "B": (50.0, 50.25, 50.0)},
+    )
+
+
+def test_unsorted_rows_come_out_sorted_by_date_and_ticker():
+    rows = [
+        RawRow("2024-01-03", "Z", 3.0),
+        RawRow("2024-01-02", "M", 2.0),

+        RawRow("2024-01-02", "Z", 1.0),
+    ]

+    assert prices.dates == ("2024-01-02", "2024-01-03")

+"""Unit tests for mdata.io.read_csv (PL-01 step 1, DATA-01)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from mdata.io import read_csv
+from mdata.types import RawRow
+
+
+def _write(tmp_path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
+    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
+    path.write_text(text)
+    return path
+
+
+def test_reads_every_row_in_file_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(
+        tmp_path,
+        "date,ticker,close\n2024-03-05,B,50.25\n2024-03-04,A,100.0\n2024-03-04,B,50\n",
+    )
+    assert read_csv(path) == [
+        RawRow(date="2024-03-05", ticker="B", close=50.25),
+        RawRow(date="2024-03-04", ticker="A", close=100.0),
+        RawRow(date="2024-03-04", ticker="B", close=50.0),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_blank_close_is_none_not_zero(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n2024-03-06,A,\n2024-03-06,B,0\n")
+    rows = read_csv(str(path))
+    assert rows[0].close is None
+    assert rows[1].close == 0.0
+
+
+def test_columns_in_any_order_and_extra_columns_ignored(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "ticker,volume,close,date\nA,10,101.41,2024-03-05\n")
+    assert read_csv(path) == [RawRow(date="2024-03-05", ticker="A", close=101.41)]
+
+
+def test_header_only_gives_no_rows(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    assert read_csv(_write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n")) == []
+
+
+def test_missing_column_raises(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker\n2024-03-04,A\n")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="close"):
+        read_csv(path)
+
+
+def test_empty_file_raises_missing_columns(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="missing column"):
+        read_csv(_write(tmp_path, ""))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["2024/03/04", "20240304", "2024-3-4", "2024-02-30", ""])
+def test_malformed_date_raises(tmp_path: Path, bad: str) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, f"date,ticker,close\n{bad},A,100\n")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="malformed date"):
+        read_csv(path)
